components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #0f7f78; color: #f4fffd; border: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.95rem; font-family: Figtree, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 0.45rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #0c6c66; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 127, 120, 0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #182433; border: 1px solid rgba(24, 36, 51, 0.22); padding: 0.55rem 0.95rem; font-family: Figtree, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 0.45rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(15, 127, 120, 0.12); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 127, 120, 0.35); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Linen field with strong line border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #f7f9fb; border: 1px solid rgba(24, 36, 51, 0.22); border-radius: 0.45rem; color: #182433; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; font-family: Figtree, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 127, 120, 0.35); }

components.name: Underline Nav
components.description: Shell section nav; active uses teal underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-nav-btn { background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #5a6b7c; font-family: Figtree, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-nav-btn.is-active, .ds-nav-btn:hover { color: #182433; border-bottom-color: #0f7f78; }

components.name: Library Tree Play
components.description: Square play control on genre/artist/album rows.

narrative.overview:
Light, linen-cool field with slate ink and a single teal signal. The shell reads as a calm desk for listening — brand is oversized and primary; chrome stays quiet so playback stays first. Atmosphere is soft wash + paper grain, never neon glow or dark-mode default.

Density is medium-loose: generous shell padding, underline navigation, nested library tree, sticky bottom player. Motion is purposeful and sparse (brand rise, view enter, player slide-up, subtle track hover).
keyCharacteristics: Light color-scheme; teal accent on small fraction of UI
Display Syne for brand / section / genre; Figtree for body and controls
Underline nav and view-mode toggles (no pill clusters)
Soft tonal panels + hairline borders; almost no drop shadows
Fixed bottom player; library as expandable tree with inline play

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent; use it for action and “now,” not decoration.

rules.name: The Light Desk Rule
rules.body: Stay in light linen/slate; do not flip the product to a dark neon skin.

rules.name: The Brand-First Type Rule
rules.body: No page headline should overpower the OneMoreTime brand block in the first shell.

rules.name: The Phone-Equals-Desktop Rule
rules.body: Same composition on narrow screens — stack shell and player; do not hide listening chrome.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Prefer border + tonal fill over multi-layer shadows.

rules.name: The Soft Square Rule
rules.body: Slightly rounded rectangles for controls; underlines for wayfinding — not capsules.

dos: Do keep OneMoreTime as the oversized Syne brand signal in the shell.
Do use teal only for primary actions, active state, and “now playing” cues.
Do prefer underline nav / view modes over pill clusters.
Do preserve the sticky player and library tree patterns when extending features.
Do keep light linen + slate; match --radius: 0.45rem and Figtree/Syne pairing.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark neon, purple-indigo gradients, or glow/bloom accents.
Don't use rounded-full pills, emoji ornament, or multi-layer card shadows.
Don't put the Disk OAuth token or secrets in client-visible UI chrome.
Don't invent a second visual world on top of this desk — extend the incumbent tokens.
